name: Interrupted Fern
desc: Interrupted Fern (Claytosmunda claytoniana): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 8 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Claytosmunda is a genus of fern. It has only one extant species, Claytosmunda claytoniana, the interrupted fern, native to Eastern Asia, Eastern United States, and Eastern Canada.
